prompt: Edit the attached approved portrait of Diana the white cat. Keep EVERYTHING identical: same head, pose, framing, eyes, ear markings (black tip only on the ear on the viewer's left), the two vertical forehead stripes, outline weight, colors and flat sticker style. Plain flat cream background (#fbf1df). Change only the bridge of her nose, as described below. Every nose accessory in this series follows ONE pattern: it sits exactly on the flat bridge of the nose, centered between the eyes and above the pink nose pad, covering the spot of the small red diagonal scratch, tilted along the same diagonal as the scratch (from upper left to lower right), about as wide as the gap between her eyes, never bigger. It is a real little physical object stuck there (as if really taken from somewhere), drawn in the same flat style with the thick cocoa outline, one shadow tone and one small highlight, casting only a tiny contact shadow on the fur. NOSE: A tiny strip of dark-green ribbed knitted scarf fabric (the same knit and green as the Fox's scarf), a flat band wrapped once over the bridge of the nose like a bandage, lying flat on the fur along the diagonal; its two little fringed ends hang loose on one side, next to her cheek. It must read clearly as a knitted scarf, not a hat.
